identity.mission: Create a zero-knowledge review platform that feels like a 'Zen Garden for Reputation'. Clean, airy, and trustworthy.
principles: Fusion: Mix SaaS utility with 'Spa/Wellness' calmness.
Emotion: Trust and Clarity over data density.
Negative Space: Aggressive whitespace to reduce anxiety.
Glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' (high saturation blur) not just transparency.

heading.usage: Headings, Big Stats, Hero Text. Use tight tracking (-0.02em).

rules: Use font-light (300) for large display numbers to feel elegant.

colors.description: A sophisticated take on the requested teal/blue. Avoids generic 'Bootstrap Teal' in favor of Deep Ocean and Ice.

structure: Main Right (Span 4): Sentiment Orb / Quick Actions

marketing.hero: Centered but with asymmetric floating glass elements.
marketing.features: Bento grid (Tetris Mode) - mix of 1x1, 2x1, and 2x2 blocks.

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-6 font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/20 hover:shadow-sky-500/40 transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700

cards.dashboard_card: rounded-2xl bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all
cards.feature_card: rounded-3xl bg-white border border-slate-100 p-8 hover:border-sky-100 transition-colors

inputs.style: rounded-xl border-slate-200 bg-white/50 focus:bg-white transition-all focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-100 h-12

navigation.sidebar: hidden md:flex flex-col w-64 border-r border-slate-100 bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-xl h-screen sticky top-0
navigation.mobile_nav: fixed bottom-4 left-4 right-4 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-200 rounded-full p-4 shadow-2xl z-50 flex justify-around

hero_bg.usage: Hero background with low opacity overlay

anti_slop_rules: Do not use generic gradients (e.g., top-to-bottom blue). Use mesh or corner blurs.
Do not center everything. Use asymmetry for interest.
Avoid 'Inter' font for headings. It looks like a template.
Never use pure black (#000000). Use Slate-900 (#0F172A).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on glass backgrounds has sufficient contrast. Use darker text colors than usual.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings are mandatory for keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Update 'index.css' with the CSS variables provided in the 'colors' section.
3. Create a 'Layout' component that handles the sidebar/mobile-nav logic.
4. Use the 'glassmorphism' classes for all dashboard containers.
5. For the 'Sentiment Orb', use a simple CSS radial gradient animation or a lightweight library.
6. Mock the Google/Facebook integration with a simple 'Connect' button that toggles a state after 2 seconds.
